_metadata.description: Validate the target scenario's package.json against the component's declared @deps before adoption.

requirements.title: Component dep declarations are parsed from the @deps header field
requirements.description: Indexer parses the optional `@deps` field as JSON (object `{"react":"^18.0.0"}` OR array `[{"name":"react","range":"^18.0.0"}]`). Missing field → empty array. Malformed JSON → observer error surfaced in the IndexComponents response. Parsed rows go into `component_dep_declarations` (soft FK to components.id). Indexer wires the deps recorder via `components.UpsertObserver` so each successful upsert re-syncs the dep set.

validation.notes: internal/deps/semver_test.go::TestParseHeaderField covers object/array/empty/malformed; sqlite_test.go::TestSQLite_SyncReplaces + TestSQLite_SyncEmptyClears verify the dep-row replacement semantics.

requirements.title: On adopt, validator compares declared deps against target scenario's package.json
requirements.description: `DepsService.ValidateAdoption(component_id, scenario)` (Connect-RPC) reads the target's `package.json` via the storage resolver, runs semver intersection against each declared dep, and returns `ok | warn | block`. `block` fires when a major-version range cannot be satisfied (or target is unparseable); `warn` fires when a dep is missing or minor/patch ranges don't intersect.

validation.notes: internal/deps/service_test.go: OK happy path, Warn missing-dep, Block incompatible-major, Block-beats-warn fold, no-declarations OK, scenario-pkg-missing error. semver_test.go::TestClassify covers ^/~/>=/exact range arithmetic across 21 cases.

requirements.title: Adoption UI surfaces dep verdicts and blocks proceed on block
requirements.description: Adoption modal shows the dep verdict before confirm. `ok` enables proceed; `warn` enables proceed with an acknowledgment checkbox; `block` disables proceed and shows the failing dep + reason.

validation.notes: features/adoptions/CreateAdoptionDialog.test.tsx: OK enables confirm + dispatches createAdoption; BLOCK disables confirm and lists the failing dep; WARN requires the acknowledgment checkbox before confirm enables.
